verdicts.reason: The two are practically identical; the only difference is a small shift in the bottom dot cluster, so neither is the better resize. Both shrink the refinery photo, a hero image in the original, to a meaningless thumbnail stuck beside 'WORLD'S'. In both, the horizontal rule cuts into the left edge of the cooling-tower photo, the dot patterns are scattered at random, the cropped black bar sits stuck to the top edge, and 'Biggest' runs almost to the right edge with no margin.
